text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day after training, I think about
working late
to take care of some work
that's piled up.
However...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Aah,
I can't take another step...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll just... use your office for a
little nap...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Buh-bye...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am. It's against the Rules of
Sei for
you to sneak a peek at my
sleeping face.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'd like my wake-up call in two hours,
please.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I end up getting kicked out. With
nothing else
to do, I go for a walk
around town.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This place feels different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a panic, I buy a present for Seiun Sky
and make
it back to campus two hours
later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now my office is different too?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hah, shocked you good, huh? My
surprise was a
huge success! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I just did a little decorating,
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I was worried about a certain trainer
missing all
this holiday cheer due to
work, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it seemed like you didn't even
realize
what day it was in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I decided to surprise ya. ☆
Heehee. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A proper trainer is supposed to bear
seasonal
events in mind, you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yet here you are, forcing your poor
trainee to be
the thoughtful one. That's
totally unacceptable.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I did get to see your jaw hit the
floor. I
guess that makes up for it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anywaaay...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What's that you're holding? I've never
seen that
bag before...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I knew it!
choice_data_list: Here's a Christmas present for you!
Here's a Christmas present for you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I really did! I knew you'd get me
something!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I believed in you enough to
boot you
outta here. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So! What did you get me? Gimme a hint!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We have some fun playing a guessing
game, with
Seiun Sky trying to figure out
what her present is.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this isn't the only surprise I
prepared. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Kill the lights!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: C'mon! Turn 'em off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Okay... here goes nothing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sea of glittering stars appears from
floor to
ceiling across the entire room.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pretty festive, huh? My present to you is
this
starry night!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Don't get misty-eyed on me yet! Look
over
there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction she's pointing to
see one
star in particular sparkling
conspicuously.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's another present from me. Let's go
catch
that star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sky pulls me toward the light. And, as it
slowly
envelops us...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now look in your hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open my hand to see what's inside...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, a fake one, but yes. It's made out
of acrylic.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm still just a kid,
this is the most I
could do
for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But the star... It's kinda nice, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And, being the amazing director that I
am,
getting a star to show its true shine
was
easy-peasy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Maybe it's a little too cheap.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To take you further behind the scenes, I
borrowed
this indoor planetarium from
someone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoops! Did I just wreck the mood?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: For real?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
choice_data_list: It's the most beautiful star I know.
It's the most beautiful star I know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I guess that means today was a huge
success!
Still, one day...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wanna grab onto a real star. Don't worry, I'll come up with a plan. ♪
